_how_to_edit: Owner-editable gallery. To add a piece: put a photo (about 800 px wide, 4:3, .webp or .jpg) in the img/collections/ folder, then copy one block below and change the words. The website reads this file every time someone opens the Collections page. See admin-guide.html.
note: Premium feature: you can update this gallery yourself
